stats.done_summary: Completed the Symbolic Pattern Reasoning research task. Developed and evaluated multiple classification algorithms including traditional ML models (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost), neural networks (MLP, LSTM, Transformer), and rule-based approaches. Implemented extensive feature engineering and hyperparameter tuning. Achieved a best test accuracy of 52.2% with Gradient Boosting, falling short of the SOTA baseline of 70%. Produced a comprehensive research report with methodology, results, analysis, and visualizations in report/report.md. All code is available in the code/ directory with intermediate results in outputs/.
